What is the molality of NaX at transport step 4, exchange 1?

A. 1.301e-04
B. 1.304e-04
C. 1.302e-04
D. 1.306e-04

Use tools as needed for PHREEQC / quantitative work.

{"path": "transport.pqi", "new_content": "TITLE 1D transport with cation exchange

# Solution 0 is the infilling (boundary) solution
SOLUTION 0

    Cl      1.0

SOLUTION 1-10
    pH      7.0
    Ca      1.0
    Cl      2.0

EXCHANGE 1-10
    X       0.001

SELECTED_OUTPUT

    -reset  false

    -cells          10
    -shifts         10
    -lengths        1.0
    -dispersivities 0.0

    -start
    10 PUNCH TRANSPORT_STEP
    20 PUNCH MOL("NaX")
    30 PUNCH MOL("CaX2")
    -end

END
"}
